baselinePeriod: Pre-change baseline from sparse evidence snapshot dated 2026-08-07; current observed counts are zero and no comparison window is established.
qualificationRequirements: observed fact: Treat this as a manual exploratory listing-copy test only; do not change app behavior.
observed fact: Keep pricing, install flow, screenshots, setup documentation, and non-copy listing fields constant for the first test.
hypothesis: Revise only the top-of-page Shopify App Store listing copy to make the user, problem, and read-only safety clearer.
assumption: The manual copy revision must remain live long enough to collect at least some post-change exposure; without exposure, result interpretation is not possible.

interpretation: A meaningful read requires at least one post-change app open or another confirmed post-change listing-traffic signal; otherwise the outcome remains inconclusive because the baseline is zero and traffic is sparse.
observed fact: Human approval is required before any marketplace listing change.
Human approval and manual marketplace edit are required before measurement.
Later evidence must be compared as exploratory and low confidence.
expectedSupportingSignal: hypothesis: After the manual copy revision, any post-change increase from the zero baseline in app_opened_count would be the primary supporting signal, especially if accompanied by at least one scan_started_count event. Because evidence is sparse, this is directional only and not proof of causation.
expectedWeakeningSignal: interpretation: The hypothesis is weakened if post-change exposure is confirmed but app_opened_count and scan_started_count remain at zero, or if app_opened_count rises without any scan_started_count increase, suggesting curiosity without qualified intent.
inconclusiveCondition: observed fact + interpretation: Results are inconclusive if post-change counts stay at zero but marketplace exposure/traffic cannot be confirmed, if instrumentation remains sparse or unreliable, or if multiple listing elements are changed at once and the copy effect cannot be isolated.
contextToMonitor: observed fact: Whether the only manual change made was the listing headline/first supporting copy.
observed fact: Date the revised copy went live and the date measurement began.
observed fact: Any manual notes about marketplace merchandising, category placement, or unusual exposure changes during the test window.
observed fact: Any parallel marketing activity that could influence app opens independently of the listing copy.
observed fact: Whether merchants who open the app can still reach and attempt the first catalog audit without product-side issues.
observed fact: Whether scan_failed_count changes materially after the test, since activation friction could mask listing-copy effects.
